propositions: Plan review certified plans with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children without detecting the contradiction, forcing full LLM re-review when amendments invalidate stale attestations

No existing plan-review criterion owns the concern of whether a ticket's acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, covering universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality contradictions
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because it receives only child ticket ids and titles, lacking the acceptance-criteria items needed to test whether siblings collectively cover parent criteria

Sibling roster construction is duplicated across three independent callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), causing eval harnesses to diverge from production on acceptance-criteria content and corrupting dogfooding data
The sibling roster is currently sent repeatedly in per-pairing instructions rather than once in the stable prefix, incurring quadratic token overhead with child count and preventing caching
Parent token estimation for container bin-packing and warm-cache gating must account for roster size once it moves into the prefix, or bins can be packed over the window budget
